identitySignals: Name is close but not identical: the agenda says 'Community School for Creative Change Charter School'. The only Oakland charter I found is 'Community School for Creative Education' (CSCE), a Waldorf-inspired K-8 charter at 2111 International Blvd. The agenda name may be a typo or a variant, which I could not confirm.
A Measure G1 middle-school grant for a charter school fits CSCE, which is an Oakland K-8 charter that includes middle grades. I found no page that lists CSCE as a G1 recipient.
No registry (ProPublica, California Secretary of State, SAM.gov) was checked or matched, so no EIN or entity number is confirmed.
research.notes: Not publishable. The agenda name ('Creative Change') does not exactly match any school I found ('Creative Education'). Searching for the exact agenda name returned nothing. I found no registry record or OUSD page confirming that this school is the Measure G1 grantee. The legal entity (probably a California nonprofit that holds the charter) was not identified, so legalName, EIN and entity number are null. A reviewer should check the OUSD G1 agenda item and the registries before publishing. The school's contact page has garbled email text, so I left the email and phone null.

profile.summary: Community School for Creative Education is a public charter school in Oakland, California, serving students in kindergarten through eighth grade. It describes itself as Waldorf-inspired and multicultural.
